message.content:
A blue magazine cover with a red vertical strip on the left and a red horizontal strip at the bottom. At the top, white text reads "TOKOH SENI 2016 PILIHAN TEMPO" and "AKROBAT SELAMATKAN EKSPOR FREEPORT." Below, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath in smaller white capitals.

The central illustration features a large, white-outlined human brain. Balanced on top of the brain are several line-drawn structures and objects: a factory with smoke, a train, a tall monument, a bridge, and a city skyline. A red upward-pointing arrow emerges from the brain's right side. Supporting the brain from below are three small, stylized human figures in blue outlines. One figure wears a red-checkered shirt. At the bottom left, light blue text reads "SIASAT DI BALIK DEBAT." Below this, smaller white text says, "DARI BERLATIH BERSAMA ORANG TUA HINGGA MENGGUNAKAN 'SELOTIP' PENGUNCI MULUT. LAPORAN DARI BELAKANG LAYAR ADU SANGGAH PEMILIHAN GUBERNUR JAKARTA." A barcode and date "16-22 JANUARI 2017" are in the bottom right corner.
